title: the home person is named as every tool names a person
line: tree.py home takes a person as Catalog.find_person does, the name with the six characters the tools print, and refuses a person merged into another: the home person is never a duplicate

steps.say: a person named as the tools print them, "Name [six characters]"

expect.why: the form CLAUDE.md prescribes names the person and sets them as home

steps.say: the file's second entry for the person merged into the first
the home person set to another, then the merged duplicate named
the duplicate, merged, named by the six characters the tools printed before the merge

expect.why: a merged person is no match: the home person stays as it was

steps.say: the duplicate named by its whole id, which the old query matched

expect.why: no way of naming a merged person makes them the home person
